scope: Equipment tag and outer size per object, taken from the v06 layout inventory

method.kept: every object carrying an equipment_id or an own_equipment_id
method.rounding: none; the bounds are copied as the inventory wrote them

what_this_does_not_give: the objects without an equipment tag, which the inventory still holds
parents, world matrices and the rest of the inventory's columns
anything the inventory did not already record
